newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOOCCER-LECHKOV EXPECTED TO START FOR BULGARIA.
newsitem.headline: SOOCCER-LECHKOV EXPECTED TO START FOR BULGARIA.

text.p: Yordan Lechkov is expected to play for Bulgaria in their World Cup group five qualifier against Luxembourg on Tuesday -- despite ignoring a call to attend a three-day training camp last week.

Bulgaria's new coach Hristo Bonev, who made an attempt to impose some new disciplinary rules on the squad, is expected to pick the striker who stayed in France for Marseille's match against Strasbourg on Sunday.
In fact Lechkov did not play in the game, but with striker Hristo Stoichkov out of the national side, Lechkov will travel to Luxembourg and is expected to play.
Seventeen players are due to leave for Luxembourg on Monday but Stoichkov, who has vowed to quit the national team in a dispute with officials, has a leg injury and will not be with them.
